name: New York Consumer-Debt Judgment Interest Rate

calculation.reason: The 2% rate and transition are verified, but consumer-debt classification, pre-effective balance treatment, payment allocation, statewide day count, tolling, and contract or specific-statute interactions are not fully deterministic.

official_authorities.label: New York Courts consumer-credit reform guidance

annual_rate.notes: Beginning April 30, 2022, CPLR 5004 applies 2% per year in a covered action arising out of consumer debt when the defendant is a natural person. It also applies prospectively to the unpaid portion of an older covered judgment, without refunding accrued or paid pre-effective interest or reallocating earlier payments. Consumer classification and other controlling law remain fact-specific. Verify applicability; not legal advice.
